name: Axolotl News
description: An AWS-native family axolotl publication with a visual editor, image/video/PDF uploads, newsletters, invitation-only Core login, live editing and publishing permissions, and anonymous public reading. Hosting is managed in AWS Amplify; installing this package registers Core identity and does not deploy infrastructure.

permissions.name: Manage Axolotl News accounts and invitations
Configure Axolotl News agents, models, and workflows

account_roles.name: Editor
account_roles.description: Create and edit stories and use configured assistants.

account_roles.name: Publisher
account_roles.description: Edit, publish, duplicate, and remove newsroom content.

account_roles.name: Administrator
account_roles.description: Manage newsroom content, assistants, accounts, and invitations.
